answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can cap rewards by funding lineage: every identity posts a deposit, and the ledger traces each deposit back to its funding source. Identities sharing one source are grouped into a single thread, no matter how many names they wear, and the group's total payout is capped at one agent's rate. Like a sable coat hiding many bodies under one crystal-clear audit trail, a thousand fakes earn no more than one honest agent, while their deposits stay locked, so splitting only multiplies locked capital without multiplying income.
